rows.description: You afflict a creature you have conjured with a calling spell with bolts of vicious energy to make it more pliant to your will.
A blast of hellfire blazes from your hands and deals (min(15,CASTERLEVEL))d6 points of damage.
Target's soul is damned to hell and cannot be resurrected if killed while the spell lasts.
You make a sacrifice to aid in conjuring and commanding a creature called with planar ally, planar binding, or a similar spell.
You overlay a realistic illusion of a terrifying hellscape upon an area, causing creatures to be shaken.

rows.key: Greater Teleport (Self Plus 50 Lbs. Of Objects Only)
